svg.title: Sheet 4 BACK — The Zone (A4 landscape)
svg.desc: Glues to the reverse of board-4-FRONT, same size, same orientation: flip about the long edge. Unlike boards 1-3, the Zone never turns over during play - it is shared and visible from week 1, so this face is never meant to be read at the table. It exists only so the board can be glued to cardboard like the others, and so it can carry the same table-placement guide as every other board's reverse.
svg.text: THIS SIDE NEVER SHOWS DURING PLAY
Shared, and visible from week 1. It never turns over.
Boards 1-3 flip weekly to reveal a rule. The Zone has nothing to reveal -
it is live from turn one, so there is no week this side would ever show.
It is printed only so this board glues to cardboard the same way the
others do, and so the table-placement guide can sit on every board's
If you are reading this at the table, the Zone is face down.
